title: Festive Norwegian Paella with Fatty Fish
description: A hearty and flavorful paella dish from Norway, featuring fatty fish and a variety of festive ingredients. Perfect for special occasions.

ingredients.name: Festive Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Infused with festive ingredients like rosemary and thyme

instructions: Heat the festive olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the fatty bacon and cook until crispy, then remove from the pan.
Add the chopped onion and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to break down.
Add the paella rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until it's coated in the oil and slightly toasted.
Add the fatty fish fillets, Norwegian shrimp, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Stir to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the fish is cooked through.
Add the crispy bacon back into the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the paella is heated through and the flavors have melded together.
